newsitem.title: USA: Trizec to buy Houston property - report.
newsitem.headline: Trizec to buy Houston property - report.

text.p: Toronto-based Trizec Corp is expected to buy a large hotel and office complex in downtown Houston for a price that could top US$250 million, the Houston Chronicle reported on Wednesday.
The newspaper, quoting real estate sources, said the deal was likely to be completed in November.

The property, called Allen Center, has been shopped around since April by owner Metropolitan Life Insurance. It includes three office buildings, the tallest having 50 stories, and a 341-room Doubletree Hotel.
Trizec already owns a nearby office complex -- Cullen Center -- in downtown Houston.
Officials at Trizec, North America's largest publicly traded real estate company, could not be reached for comment.
